title: Chore health
description: Find chores that are skipping, failing or costing more than they should.

steps.name: check
steps.prompt: Use the control plane API at $API_URL (curl is fine; JSON responses). Useful routes: GET /projects, GET /projects/:id, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id/events, GET /graph/:id, GET /workflows, GET /workflows/:id, GET /brief?hours=N, GET /audit?limit=N, GET /chores, GET /ledgers?status=signed, GET /proposals, POST /workflows, POST /projects, POST /projects/:id/continue, POST /chores, POST /tasks/:id/go. GET /chores and, for each, its recent tasks via GET /tasks and the sessions behind them. Flag: last three fires all skipped or stopped, cost rising week on week, same park every fire, next fire time missing. Write CHORES.md with one line per chore and a recommended action (pause, change mode, widen a grant, fix the prompt). Pause any chore whose last three fires all failed via POST /chores/:id/pause and say so.
